messages:
Ryan: taking handoff now. Observed noisy signals in kv-cache (eu-west1) last ~2h. Details below — please read if you're covering.

Ryan: Known issues:
- kv-cache latency spikes (p95 -> 220ms, p99 -> 480ms) on eu-west1 cache nodes
- kv-autoscaler alert flapping (scale_up/scale_down in <5m)
- streaming endpoints (chat) showing ~3% retries, mostly in eu-west1

Ryan: Impact: customer-facing latencies up for a small subset of requests; no widespread errors. No active paged incident, but noisy alerts and slightly elevated user latencies.

Ryan: Actions taken:
- Rolled back recent caching config uploaded 10:15 UTC
- Increased alert debounce for kv-autoscaler to 6m (temporary)
- Opened ticket INF-4127 to track root cause

Ryan: Handoff notes: I'm on-call until 14:00 UTC; Marta will take 14:00-22:00 UTC. Please avoid non-urgent deploys to eu-west1 for next 6h.

Marta: ACK. I'll keep watch on dashboards and set pager thresholds if it starts paging. What's the query for the noisy alert?

Alex: Use this query in dataplane logs/filter:
```
metric:kv_latency{region="eu-west1"} | avg by node (p99)
```
That should filter the nodes flapping.

Jamie: FYI if we see >10% retries escalate to infra and notify product. Also suggest opening a short postmortem template in INF-4127.

Marta: I'll mute the low-signal alert channel for 30m and watch the higher-confidence ones. Adding note to runbook: check node memory and background GC.

oncall-bot: 1765803420 ALERT: kv-autoscaler flapping on eu-west1 — 7 events in last 10m (link: https://redwood.infra/alerts/17658)

Ryan: Thanks — tagging @Alex and @Jamie. If anyone needs the exact nodes list ping me and I'll share.

Alex: grabbing nodes list now, will paste in thread if relevant.

Marta: taking over. Ryan — leaving a pointer to INF-4127 with initial triage.

Jamie: thx. I'll open a quick PR to tweak debounce defaults in case we need it later :thumbsup:

Marta: handing off completed. I'm the active oncall.
